summary.standard_gate: 3/3 stable rounds, exit IP agreement, download >=64 KiB/s, upload >=16 KiB/s, risk feeds available and no known-bad match
summary.fast_gate: 3/3 stable rounds, download >= 256 KiB/s and upload >= 64 KiB/s; positive reputation confirmation not required, known-bad IPs excluded
summary.chain_direction: public node as entry hop; user-owned home endpoint as final hop via dialer-proxy
summary.warning: Cloud runner results do not guarantee mainland reachability. Chain template placeholders must be replaced locally; never commit home credentials.

cloud_tcp.meaning: TCP reachability only; not proxy handshake, tunnel, speed, reputation, or mainland reachability.

protocol.meaning: Mihomo tunnel and HTTP egress from cloud; not a mainland China test.

risk.warning: Not listed in threat feeds does not prove an IP is clean; this is not a reputation guarantee.

stability.meaning: Repeated tunnel establishment, consistent exit IP, 256 KiB HTTPS download and 64 KiB HTTPS upload; not a mainland measurement.
